Alloy P = 1 × 150 = 150 g; Alloy Q = 2 × 150 = 300 g. Verification: 0.80 × 150 + 0.50 × 300 = 120 + 150 = 270 g of gold in 450 g total = 60%. Answer: 150 g of Alloy P and 300 g of Alloy Q.
